cohort: 206 euthyroid pregnant women using levothyroxine compared to 449 women with uncomplicated term pregnancies.
finding: Euthyroid levothyroxine-using pregnant women had significantly lower PAPP-A levels and higher UtA PI in the first trimester compared to the control group, indicating altered placental function, but the frequency of obstetric complications did not appear to be dose-dependent.
